decisionsTitle: The feedback form's event picker filters as you type (amending §676)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-09**, with a QA screenshot of «Cum a fost» (`/ro/contact/spune-ne?tip=cum-a-fost`) showing «Evenimentul» set to «Altceva / în general»: «Also I need to be able the filter the events here». The picker (§676) lists every published event of the last 90 days and the next 30 — the held ones first, the most recent first, then the ones ahead (`pickerOrder`) — and with a weekly group run that is a long native list on a phone, a dozen «Happy Monday» rows told apart only by their day.

**Decision. A picker you can filter, without losing the plain form.**

- **The native select stays in the server's HTML exactly as it was.** `<select name="event" id="f-event">`, «Altceva / în general» first, each event «title — day» in the page's date words (`formatDay`, short, as before), in `pickerOrder`'s order. It is what a browser without JavaScript posts, and what the server reads; nothing about the post, the draft cookie (§142), `?eveniment=` preselection, the error summary's link to `#f-event` or the date box that follows changes. The page now builds the rows once, as plain data (`PickerOption`: `value` the slug or `""`, `label` the title, `kind`, `day` as `YYYY-MM-DD`, `when` the same day in the page's words), and the native options are drawn from them.
- **Over eight rows, a client island stands in front of it** — `src/modules/feedback/ui/EventPickerFilter.tsx`. The server wraps the native select in it as its children and hands it the rows, the value chosen and the words, all plain strings (§353, §370: never an element). Until it runs — on the server, while the page hydrates, and for good without JavaScript — it draws the select it was given. Once it runs it draws MUI's `Autocomplete` (already installed) under the same label «Evenimentul», with the select's id on its box, and a hidden `<input name="event">` carrying the slug chosen; the select is gone from the form, so exactly one `event` is posted. A choice made in the native select before hydration is kept: the island reads it as it takes over.
- **The box filters as one types**, case- and diacritic-insensitive (the registration form's own `foldForSearch`, §463: NFD with the marks stripped), every word typed found anywhere in the title or the day — «crosul» finds «Crosul», «brasov» finds «Brașov», «happy oct» the October Mondays. «Altceva / în general» is the first row while the box is empty, and whenever what was typed finds no event — then with a row under it that says «Niciun eveniment găsit» / "No event found" and cannot be chosen — because it is the answer for a message about no event and is never out of reach. **While what was typed matches an event, «Altceva» steps out of the list**, so the first match is the row the keyboard is on and Enter picks the event searched for. The review of 2026-10-09 found why: MUI's combobox highlights the value chosen whenever it is among the rows (`syncHighlightedIndex`), «Altceva» is the value by default, and with it always in the list «crosul» + Enter picked «Altceva» — and could silently replace an event already chosen. Dropping `autoHighlight` instead would not have been enough, since the value's own highlight stays. Cleared, the box shows «Altceva» first again; typed, «altceva» or «general» find no event and so bring it back.
- **Three chips above the box**, «Toate» / «Curse» / «Alergări de grup» ("All" / "Races" / "Group runs"), in a group named «Arată» / "Show", each `aria-pressed`. A chip narrows the list to its kind; «Toate» keeps every kind, a hike or a coffee included. The kind is the event's existing type — `RACE` a race, `GROUP_RUN` a group run, the rest «other» (`pickerKind`) — with no column of its own. The chips are drawn only when both kinds are among the events, since otherwise one of them would empty the list.
- **Phone first.** At 320 pixels the list opens below the box, never flipped above it (the keyboard takes the bottom of the screen); every row is at least 44 pixels (BR-REQ-041-01 criterion 6), the title on the first line and the day under it in the secondary colour; every chip is 44 pixels tall. Before the island runs, when it will draw the chips, the same row of chips already stands above the native select — invisible, out of the accessibility tree, not pressable — so the field and everything under it do not jump down by a row as the island takes over under a reader's thumb; a browser that says it runs no script (`@media (scripting: none)`) gives that row no room. The box's text is 16 pixels, or iOS zooms the page into it. Keyboard and screen reader go through MUI's own combobox semantics; the open and close buttons are named «Deschide lista evenimentelor» / «Închide lista evenimentelor». Both colour schemes follow from the theme's tokens alone.
- **Eight rows or fewer, «Altceva» counted, mount no island** (`PICKER_NATIVE_MAX`, `pickerFilters`): eight rows open on a phone without a scroll worth filtering, and the page then ships no JavaScript for the picker at all.
- **Loaded only where it is drawn.** The island is imported by the feedback page alone, never by a layout or a shared component, so it is in that route's chunk and its client reference is emitted only on the forms that have the picker («Cum a fost», «O reclamație») when the list is long — never on step 1, «O sugestie» or «Girl Zone», and never in the site's shared bundle. Its rules live in a pure module (`src/modules/feedback/domain/event-picker.ts`) whose only value import is the fold, so it carries neither Zod nor the server's configuration (§489).

**Why this island earns its place (AGENTS.md §1.5).** Filtering as one types needs a script; no native control does it while posting a slug. The page stays a Server Component, the form still works and posts the same `event` with JavaScript off, the island costs nothing on the pages that do not draw it, and nothing new is installed.

**Refused.** *A server-side search with a round trip*: the list is at most about 120 rows, already in the page; a request per letter would cost a function and a database wake for nothing. *A `<datalist>`*: it posts the visible text, not the slug, so the server would have to resolve a title back to an event (and a series' dates share one), and Android renders it poorly. *A new dependency*: MUI's `Autocomplete` is already installed and already serves the country pickers (§463).

**Tests.** `tests/unit/feedback/event-picker.test.ts` (the pure filter: diacritics, case, every word, the day's words, the chips, «Altceva» first on an empty box or when nothing matches and out of the list while something does, «Niciun eveniment găsit», eight rows or fewer → no island); `tests/unit/feedback/feedback-page-event-picker.test.ts` (the page rendered on the server: the native select with the same id, name and options whatever the length, wrapped in the island only over eight rows, the island handed plain data and the words in both languages, and the island itself drawing nothing but its select on the server — and, when its chips will be drawn, their row already, hidden, unread and unpressable); `tests/e2e/feedback.spec.ts` now reads what is posted by its name, reads the offered slugs from the server's HTML, and — when the database's picker is long enough for the island — checks the chips, «Altceva» first, the list below the box, 44-pixel rows, «Niciun eveniment găsit», types part of the first event's title without diacritics and presses Enter — the first match on top, «Altceva» out of the list, and `event` holding that event's slug — then picks it again by a tap, and finds «Cum a fost: <title>» in the captured message's subject on `/devs`.
changelogLine: - **«Evenimentul» filters as you type** — on «Cum a fost» and «O reclamație», a long event list becomes a search box that finds an event by part of its title or its day, with or without diacritics, and Enter picks the first event found; «Altceva / în general» heads the list while the box is empty or nothing matches, and «Toate» / «Curse» / «Alergări de grup» chips narrow it; without JavaScript, or with eight rows or fewer, the plain list stays. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Cum a fost» or «O reclamație» with more than eight rows in «Evenimentul» («Altceva / în general» counted), when the page renders, then the server's HTML still holds the native `<select name="event" id="f-event">` with the same options in the same order, and once JavaScript runs it is replaced by a box under the same label that filters as one types — case- and diacritic-insensitive, every word typed found in the title or the day — with «Altceva / în general» the first row while the box is empty or what was typed matches no event («Niciun eveniment găsit» / "No event found" under it then) and out of the list while it matches one, so that typing part of an event's title and pressing Enter chooses that event, rows at least 44 pixels tall opening below the box, «Toate» / «Curse» / «Alergări de grup» chips drawn only when both races and group runs are among the events (their row's place held before the island runs, so the field does not move), and exactly one `event` posted, the chosen event's slug; with eight rows or fewer, or without JavaScript, the native select is the picker and posts as before (2026-10-09, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
